events.what_it_is: An immersive Good Girl fragrance lab marking the scent's 10th anniversary, with olfactory discovery, interactive challenges, beauty experiences and a café area.
events.what_is_free: Admission is free. Interactive challenges can yield prizes such as miniatures and makeup services, and the first 100 guests are advertised to receive a Carolina Herrera x Myka fro-yo.
events.caveats: Timed RSVP is available, but NYC Plugged explicitly says walk-ins are allowed based on capacity. Prize inventory and the first-100 fro-yo offer are limited.
events.practical_notes: Friday September 11, noon–6 PM; Saturday September 12, 11 AM–6 PM; Sunday September 13, 11 AM–3 PM. Walk-in access is capacity-dependent; use the Eventbrite page if you want a timed reservation.

events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW public pop-up with hair and makeup refresh stations, a photo booth, legwear displays and on-site customization.
events.what_is_free: Public admission, coffee, branded stickers, hairstyle touch-ups and the photo booth are advertised as free. Embroidery is free only with purchase of the specified 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.caveats: Current listings state the pop-up is open to the public. Complimentary items and services may be capacity- or inventory-limited. Hand embroidery is tied to purchase of the advertised knee highs.
events.practical_notes: Saturday September 12 and Sunday September 13, noon–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No advance RSVP or host-approval step is published.

events.event_name: The Coven Club by Alani Nu
events.what_it_is: A five-story immersive Alani Nu fall-flavor experience built around Witch's Brew, Ruby Apple and Voodoo Vanilla, with themed mocktails, product sampling and rooftop programming.
events.what_is_free: Free RSVP access to the experience, including advertised samples and themed drinks while available.
events.caveats: Alani Nu's official page says this is 18+ only, space is limited, and RSVP does not guarantee admission. Treat this as a free guest-list style RSVP rather than guaranteed entry.
events.practical_notes: Saturday September 12 and Sunday September 13, 9 AM–7 PM. The official Alani Nu event page exposes separate RSVP buttons for each date and is the best current access path.
